data.long_meaning: The name Alaine is derived from the Greek name 'Alauna' which means noble or calm. In Latin, the name is Alania, meaning 'not foreign'. The name Alaine is often associated with strong and gentle women in literature and history. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alaine usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, gentle, and bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Alaine
in_latin.meaning: Alaine nomen femininum est, quod origine a nomine Francicum derivatur.
in_latin.long_meaning: Alaine nomen femininum est, quod origine a nomine Francicum derivatur, unde etymologia sua est. Hoc nomen in Francia antiqua usitatum erat, et in medio aevo in Christiana Ecclesia apparuit. Nomen Alaine significat 'felicitas' aut 'beata', et in traditionibus Christianis, persona qui nomen huius portat, est signum felicitatis et beatitudinis. In medio aevo, nomen Alaine in Christiana Ecclesia apparuit, et in saeculis XIV et XV, erat nomen communissimum in Europa.

Today, the name Alaine is still used in many Christian cultures, symbolizing the values of nobility, humility, and spirituality.
